summary: A complete single-player battle royale loop on an original procedural island: stage, skiff drop, wing-sail, loot nine weapons across five rarities, fight 23 perception-limited bots through the full Calmfield/Riftstorm schedule, win, results, requeue.
notes: Local bot mode only: the authoritative 30 Hz match runs in the browser behind a loopback link; there is no network server, client prediction, Rapier or streaming. Verified by 54 simulation tests, headless bot soaks and automated headless-Edge play from a nested sub-path; no human played it and the synthesised audio was never listened to. Default Quick Drop is the standard ~13 minute pace; choose Blitz on the menu for a ~6 minute match. Crouch is on C as well as Left Ctrl because browsers reserve Ctrl+W.
